models.name: todo_list_system_configs
models.description:
System-wide configuration and operational parameters for the Todo List application.

This model stores key-value pairs representing global settings, feature toggles, and core system options that govern application-level behavior. Each configuration is uniquely identified by its key and may store settings such as default timezone, maintenance flags, operational feature gates, or reserved identifiers for system processes.

Configurations in this table are not user- or admin-specific—they apply to the entire deployment and provide a foundation for evolving operational requirements. All updates are tracked with timestamps, and soft deletion is supported for historical audit and safe rotation of system configuration elements.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key for the system configuration record.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifying the system setting. Examples include 'default_timezone', 'feature_maintenance_mode', or other core options. Must be unique within this table.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value as a string. Can store serialized data for complex options but typically represents a scalar system setting relevant to the business or application.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the purpose and business context for this configuration entry. Useful for documenting intent and supporting operational maintenance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration entry was created. Used for audit purposes and operational monitoring.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the configuration entry. Enables tracking of modifications for audit and compliance.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating soft deletion of the configuration entry. Used for operational safety and rollback capability.

models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Represents registered, authenticated individual end users of the Todo List service.

Each user can create, view, edit, complete, and delete only their own todo items. Users are granted no visibility or control over any other user's account or related data. This table also stores authentication credentials, unique email address, locked status for moderation, and timestamps for account lifecycle.

Audit requirements mandate that all status changes and deletion actions are logged in subsidiary tables. Soft deletion is achieved through the deleted_at column.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address of the user. Used for login and system notifications. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for secure authentication. Never stores plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: Account lock status. True if the user is suspended or blocked by admin for policy or security reasons.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the most recent update to the user profile or credentials.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Tracks active and expired authentication sessions for regular users.

Each session records the user ID, connection details, session creation, and expiration times. Enables audit trails of user activity, tracing access for security, compliance, and privacy enforcement. Sessions are subsidiary and always reference their user owner. No password/token fields are stored here; sessions solely track connection context and lifecycle.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or client origin.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL, if any, for the client establishing the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session ended or was invalidated.

models.name: todo_list_user_deletion_logs
models.description:
Logs events when user accounts are deleted for audit, compliance, or privacy purposes.

Captures the user deleted, time of action, reason (e.g., GDPR, user request, admin action), and administrative actor if applicable. Used for traceability, regulatory audits, and troubleshooting account lifecycle events. Deletion logs are managed solely by system or admin workflows – users do not interact with this table directly.

plainFields.name: deleted_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: ID of the admin who performed the account deletion. Null if self-deleted. Used for audit when admin initiated.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for deletion (GDPR, user request, admin suspension, etc).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the deletion event occurred.

models.name: todo_list_admins
models.description:
Represents administrators with privileged access to system oversight, user management, and moderation.

Admins can view and manage users and any todo in the system, and can impose status/actions such as account locking or deletion for compliance or support. Authentication credentials, unique email, role flags, lifecycle timestamps, and soft deletion status are included. Only privileged personnel are represented; regular users are never present in this table.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address of the admin for login and notification. Must not overlap normal users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure admin authentication. Plain passwords are never retained.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: Admin account lock status. True if administrator is currently suspended from system use.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Administrative role or privilege class (e.g., superadmin, moderator). Determines access boundaries within admin workflows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time of last admin profile or credential update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the admin account. Null if admin is active.

models.name: todo_list_admin_sessions
models.description:
Tracks each login session for administrators, providing traceability for privileged access and sensitive actions.

Each record ties to an admin account and logs session metadata including connection IP, access URL, referrer, and timestamps. Sessions support compliance, intrusion detection, and accountability. This table never stores authentication secrets, only session lifecycle information.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: References the admin who owns this session. {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the admin's session origin.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Access URL or service endpoint for this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Client's referrer for this session connection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session began.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the admin session was closed or expired.

models.name: todo_list_admin_deletion_logs
models.description:
Records administrative account deletions for audit fulfillment and policy compliance.

Contains deletion event data: admin whose account was deleted, actor executing the deletion (if different), reason code or explanation, and timestamp. Supports forensic review, compliance, and user/account lifecycle transparency. Entries are generated by system or superadmin operations; never directly manipulated by standard admins.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin whose account was deleted. {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: deleted_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: ID of the higher privilege admin who performed this deletion, if any. Null if self-deleted.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Narrative or code for the account deletion cause.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the account was deleted.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Business entity representing an individual todo item belonging to a single end-user.

Each row records one actionable task with immutable ownership. Enforces all business rules for title, description, and allowed state transitions (pending, completed, archived). Tracks timestamps for creation, last update, and optional completion. Title validation enforced at creation and update. Foreign key to the user table ensures todos are always associated with a valid owner, but remain private to that user unless reviewed by an admin.

Supports efficient per-user queries and batch actions within the user's scope. No group, tag, or collaborative features are present. Hard deletion applies per requirements. State management compliant with audit and admin access handled via external tables.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies each todo item.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign Key. References the owning user. Must reference an existing user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title. Required for creation and update. 1–100 characters, validated for non-whitespace content.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional todo description. Maximum 1000 characters. Can be omitted or set to null on creation/update.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Todo status: permitted values are 'pending', 'completed', or 'archived'. Enforces business lifecycle transitions.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date in ISO 8601 format. Null if not set. Must not be in the past for creation/update.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the todo item was created (stored as UTC). Required for data lifecycle and ordering.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the last time this todo was updated. Maintains user and admin accountability.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp for when the todo was marked as completed. Null unless status is 'completed'.

models.name: todo_list_audit_logs
models.description:
Audit log of security-relevant, admin, and business actions across the todo system.

This table records every important operation or event that impacts system security, user privacy, admin oversight, or compliance requirements. Log entries are immutably written for each actionable event: todo create/edit/delete, user/admin login/logout, permission checks, admin moderation, authentication failures, and any sensitive business action.

Each entry references the acting entity (user or admin), affected todo (if applicable), session, and includes rich event and context metadata for compliance, investigations, and business monitoring. The log supports traceability, operational monitoring, security audits, and legal reporting. Entries are never deleted or updated: append-only, supporting strict historical query and forensics.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the audit log entry. Globally unique identifier assigned at insertion, ensuring each record is immutable and traceable.

foreignFields.name: actor_user_id
foreignFields.description: References the user who performed the action, if a user initiated this event. Nullable; use actor_admin_id for admin actions. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: References the admin who performed the action, if admin initiated. Nullable; use actor_user_id for user-initiated events. {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: References the user session tied to the action, if event is linked to a user session. Nullable. {@link todo_list_user_sessions.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_session_id
foreignFields.description: References the admin session if the action was performed during an admin session. Nullable. {@link todo_list_admin_sessions.id}.

foreignFields.name: affected_todo_id
foreignFields.description: References a specific todo if the action/event affects a todo. Nullable for global/auth events not linked to a todo. {@link todo_list_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: event_action
plainFields.description: Describes the action taken or event type (e.g., 'todo_create', 'todo_edit', 'user_login', 'admin_lock_user', 'permission_denied'). Application-defined event type for robust filtering and analytics.

plainFields.name: event_status
plainFields.description: Result status of the event ('success', 'failure', 'denied', etc). Enables filtering audit logs by outcome and error/failure reporting in compliance reviews.

plainFields.name: event_context
plainFields.description: Free-form context data (JSON or string) capturing additional details—affected columns, before/after state, request metadata, error codes. Used for deep auditing, investigation, or legal review. Can be null if event has no extra context.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the actor/session generating the event, if available. Nullable.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string (browser/app version) from HTTP request, if captured. Nullable. Supports threat analysis and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp (UTC) when the audit event was logged. Immutable and required for all records. Used for temporal queries, trending, and compliance timelines.
